event.value: He pays fair, tips the mule, and helped right her wagon in the mud. A courteous young man — she keeps the list of his virtues where she can see it, and it is getting shorter than the other one.

She told him about the goblin lady past the second gate who paid in jam — best jam on the road. He heard 'enemy settlement' and promised the roads would soon be safe for trade again. The stories dried up mid-sentence.

notes: Modeled at the EARLY stage: warmth as strategy — she hides the truth in jokes and stories because warmth might work where evidence failed. Affection 20 is the highest in the hub, and that is the horror: she genuinely likes the man who is ruining everything she loves. Her private stake (she traded the old diplomatic roads; some people behind the gates are her customers and friends) keeps suspicion at 15 despite the warmth. Escalation per profile: mid-arc the warmth gets effortful and the news darker; late-runs she keeps the smile as her last open door and says what it costs. Boundary, intact: her wagon never carries 'liberated treasure'. Softens instantly if he asks after a settlement by name. Deltas sum to current dimensions.
